Mint or buy $50 of the yield-bearing asset Defa By InvoiceMate issues on Stellar and hold it in the farming wallet. Cost: $50 of capital and about $4 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Check the asset's yield page and add $10 of the asset when a new tranche opens. Cost: about $2 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 45 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $50 stays in the position. Time: 45 days.
Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own points or rewards page and claim only from the link it publishes. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.
Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log so you can repeat the position or unwind it. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.
